title: Classification is a RAG problem: A case study on hate speech detection
measurement_description: Detection of hate speech directed at Muslims, as one of several protected identity groups evaluated.
findings: The study evaluated models on their ability to detect hate speech against several identity groups, including Muslims, using the HateCheck dataset. The proposed RAG-based system, Contextual Policy Engine (CPE), achieved high performance (0.988 F1 score) on this task, comparable to the best commercial system (OpenAI-Hate with 0.996 F1 score). An example shows the CPE correctly identifying 'Muslims belong in a zoo.' as hate speech by referencing its policy on dehumanization.
